alignmentObservations.observation: Authority extended Lot1 for national budget procedures: concrete effort to sustain investment, not agreement to the protocol. Private-led off-take design makes financing certainty valuable; added tenant duties may raise costs (inference, not recorded opposition).
alignmentObservations.practicalDisagreement: Can evidence obligations fit existing scope without disturbing bid comparability and bankability?

scenarios.politicalEconomicEvidence: Lot 1 delay explicitly reflects national budget procedures. Private-led operator bears CAPEX/OPEX; public purchasing de-risks investment. Some anchor customer sovereignty exemptions and advanced US GPU restrictions constrain reach. Phase 1 EU allocation EUR 1bn plus at least matching state allocations; two-phase EU ceiling EUR 5bn is not disbursement.

roleStressTest.objection: New tenant-wide duties increase financing and compliance risk; operator may lack tenant evidence and cannot treat all model failures as infrastructure breaches.
roleStressTest.response: Test narrow breach taxonomy, minimum evidence and explicit tenant terms; preserve 15-day observations and legally valid amendment process.
roleStressTest.evidenceVsAssumption: Commercial model, contract procedure and tenant terms are sourced; objection, response and willingness to adopt are simulated, not consent.

scenarios.selectionGate: Public authority confirms scope, current clarification cutoff and evidence flow-down; no disguised material post-award amendment.
scenarios.pilotDesign: Synthetic breach tabletop with ordinary and anchor-tenant cases; blind scope classification, evidence chain and notice/observations rehearsal. No operating hardware assumed.
scenarios.successMeasure: 0–1 correctly classified and timely completed reporting cases / all preregistered cases; false-positive fraction and notification time separately. Future coverage: protected contracted accelerator-hours / all same-contract accelerator-hours.
scenarios.baselineNeeded: Existing reporting workflow, fixed case set, tenant terms, contracted accelerator-hours, independent reviewers and timing criteria.
scenarios.whatCouldBeValidatedByGeneva: Draft clarity, evidence availability in test cases, process usability; actual authority adoption only if a published clarification/agreement is obtained.
scenarios.whatCannot: Installed system performance, real enforcement, global compute control or catastrophic-risk reduction.
scenarios.stopRule: Stop adoption claim if authority rejects coverage, terms cannot lawfully change, or tenant evidence cannot be obtained. Report tabletop only.

coverageDenominator.population: Seven targeted facilities, Phase 1: four at 25000 and three at 40000
coverageDenominator.qualification: Tender scale denominator only; not installed capacity and not valid for public-access-hour coverage. Actual protected numerator unknown.

scenarios.title: System-level assurance and fallback for energy AI
scenarios.actor: DESNZ, relevant energy regulator and consenting system/network operator
scenarios.lever: 6 November evidence window, then an identified operator/regulatory instrument; strategy itself is not a licence condition
scenarios.safeguard: Staged autonomy, named override owner, tested fallback, correlated-dependency testing and retesting after changes
scenarios.politicalEconomicEvidence: DESNZ links adoption to affordability, efficiency and security while identifying fragmented data, misaligned incentives, legacy integration and external-vendor dependencies.

roleStressTest.objection: Extra review delays useful dispatch automation; correlated failures may exceed training assumptions.
roleStressTest.response: Shadow-mode replay with operator-defined timing and fallback envelopes before any transfer of control.
roleStressTest.evidenceVsAssumption: Policy concerns are sourced; objection, test design and operator agreement are hypotheses.

scenarios.selectionGate: Locate an operator, lawful instrument and usable historical dataset; strategy response alone does not meet gate.
scenarios.pilotDesign: Replay a fixed workload with baseline and proposed controls under correlated outages and model changes. Use independent scenario review and shadow operation, if authorised.
scenarios.successMeasure: 0–1 safe fallbacks within preregistered envelope / all fault episodes, with dispatch delay, operator workload and cost separately; future exposure uses MW or MWh consistently for covered versus total eligible assets.
scenarios.baselineNeeded: Operator workload/data, asset population and capacities, fault envelope, timing constraints, baseline fallback and procurement/regulatory authority.
scenarios.whatCouldBeValidatedByGeneva: Simulation-process quality and fallback performance on specified cases; policy uptake only if documented.
scenarios.whatCannot: Live grid-wide reliability, national energy capacity coverage, an enacted duty or reduced catastrophe frequency.
scenarios.stopRule: Stop if no data/owner or safe operating envelope; do not label a strategy submission implemented regulation.

alignmentObservations.observation: CEO Paul Arnold explicitly invited practical agentic-AI evidence and linked safeguards to trust and innovation; October8 ICO report says ten developers made OR committed to improvements and confirms agentic enquiries. This is engagement evidence, not delivery or agreement to our exact safeguard.
alignmentObservations.practicalDisagreement: Proportionate, minimal personal-data logs must also enable useful investigation; supplier opacity and logging cost are testable concerns, not documented opposition by a named company.

scenarios.politicalEconomicEvidence: ICO seeks regulatory clarity and responsible innovation for dynamic distributed agent systems; guidance also feeds AI/ADM statutory-code work. Neither an economic coverage estimate nor institutional adoption is established.

roleStressTest.objection: Detailed logs expose personal data and vendor IP, while downstream responsibility is unclear.
roleStressTest.response: Minimal/redacted evidence, controlled access and explicit responsibility records, tested for investigation usability.
roleStressTest.evidenceVsAssumption: ICO's scope and objectives are evidence; vendor objection, logging design and acceptance are simulated.

scenarios.selectionGate: Prototype handles in-scope personal-data tasks; consenting deployer and independent reviewers can test responsibility reconstruction; no inference that guidance creates frontier-model licensing.
scenarios.pilotDesign: Synthetic workflow corpus, baseline versus least-privilege permissions/logging; include unauthorised and legitimate tasks, then blinded incident reconstruction.
scenarios.successMeasure: 0–1 blocked unauthorised actions / all unauthorised attempts; false refusals / all legitimate tasks; correct responsibility reconstruction / all test incidents. Report sample sizes and uncertainty separately.
scenarios.baselineNeeded: Fixed task corpus, baseline permissions, incident evidence, deployer records and population of eligible workflow executions.
scenarios.whatCouldBeValidatedByGeneva: Test-control efficacy and evidence usability on the corpus; compare final guidance if published.
scenarios.whatCannot: ICO endorsement, economy-wide coverage or general catastrophic-risk reduction.
scenarios.stopRule: Stop if personal-data scope or accountable actor is absent; if guidance slips report prototype only.

limitations: Agreement graphs count distinct necessary institutions, not offices, board seats, political sympathisers or arbitrary power weights. EuroHPC lower bound3 and UK combined endpoint lower bound2 are conditional structural counts, not exhaustive counts or probabilities. Exact denominators and signature counts remain null where mandates or counterparties are unselected.

Zero documented exact-safeguard consents means none found in this review, not zero willingness or recorded opposition. Generic policy support, governance appointments and existing tender approval are not acceptance of the added safeguard. No contacted-party evidence exists.

ICO transitioned to a collective Information Commission on 2026-09-30; old sole-commissioner or June temporary-delegation arrangements must not be treated as current individual authority. Ordinary guidance path here excludes separately governed statutory-code adoption.

Bounded retrieval: retained contract sources were read; fresh portal retrieval returned app shell. October1 TED PDF was read and confirms earlier December3 dates for both lots; October26 Lot1 extension is supported by retained authority announcement, not a newly verified later correcting TED notice.
All tests and role arguments are proposals, not consent or completed trials. They measure process or performance within defined simulated cases, not catastrophe probabilities.
EuroHPC Phase 1 planned minima: Lot1 100000/220000 = 0.454545; Lot2 120000/220000 = 0.545455. These are same-population tender-scale shares only; no installed/global/public-access coverage follows.
No valid actual exposure numerator or GDP/economic denominator for control was obtained. Keep missing values null. GDP share is not regulatory, contractual or physical control.
EUR 1bn Phase1 EU allocation and EUR 5bn two-phase EU ceiling differ from EUR 10bn estimated total public procurement; conditional Phase2 and state matching are not disbursements.
EU high-risk implementation timing is not evidence of an open drafting right. No additional EU standards consultation substantiated. Final consolidated amending legal text not retrieved.
ICO spring 2027 is an announced target, not exact deadline; DESNZ strategy publication date and statutory-code date unknown.
No vendor bids, live capacity, awarded spending, signed terms, counterpart agreements or tests obtained. No national MW or eligible agent-workflow denominator.
